nodes.name: ClickUp Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers when a ClickUp task status changes to 'IN WORDPRESS ANLEGEN'

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Configuration: wordpress_url, freigegeben_folder_id, wordpress_folder_id, google_sheet_id

nodes.name: Get Task Details
nodes.notes: GET ClickUp task to retrieve custom fields: Link zum Beitrag, Meta Title, Meta Description, Themen-Cluster

nodes.name: Extract Data
nodes.notes: Extract Google Doc ID, meta_title, meta_description, themen_cluster from ClickUp task custom fields

nodes.name: Read Google Doc
nodes.notes: Read the Google Doc content as JSON via Google Docs API

nodes.name: Convert Doc to HTML
nodes.notes: Convert Google Docs JSON content to clean HTML suitable for WordPress

nodes.name: Search WordPress Category
nodes.notes: Search for Themen-Cluster category in WordPress

nodes.name: Check Category Exists
nodes.notes: Check if the WordPress category was found or needs to be created

nodes.name: Category Exists?
nodes.notes: Route: true = needs creation, false = category already exists

nodes.name: Create WordPress Category
nodes.notes: Create the Themen-Cluster as a new WordPress category

nodes.name: Merge Category ID (Created)
nodes.notes: Extract the category ID from the newly created category

nodes.name: Merge Category ID (Existing)
nodes.notes: Pass through the existing category ID

nodes.name: Merge Category
nodes.notes: Merge the two category branches back together

nodes.name: Prepare Post Data
nodes.notes: Consolidate category ID and check for featured image

nodes.name: Has Featured Image?
nodes.notes: Check if there is a featured image URL to upload

nodes.name: Download Featured Image
nodes.notes: Download the featured image from the URL found in the ClickUp task

nodes.name: Upload Featured Image
nodes.notes: Upload the featured image to WordPress media library

nodes.name: Extract Media ID
nodes.notes: Extract the WordPress media ID from the upload response

nodes.name: No Image
nodes.notes: No featured image available - set media ID to 0

nodes.name: Merge Image
nodes.notes: Merge image upload branches back together

nodes.name: Create WordPress Post
nodes.notes: Create a new WordPress post as draft with the content from Google Docs, category, and featured image

nodes.name: Set RankMath Meta
nodes.notes: Set RankMath SEO meta (title, description, focus keyword) on the created post. Falls back gracefully if RankMath API is not available.

nodes.name: Set RankMath Meta Fallback
nodes.notes: Fallback: Update post meta directly via WP REST API if RankMath endpoint is unavailable

nodes.name: Move Google Doc
nodes.notes: Move Google Doc from 'Freigegeben' folder to 'WordPress Angelegt' folder via Google Drive API

nodes.name: Update Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Update Google Sheet: set status to 'in_wordpress' and add the WordPress post URL

nodes.name: Update ClickUp Task
nodes.notes: Set the 'wordpress_url' custom field on the ClickUp task with the WordPress post URL
